name: Chocolate Caramels
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put butter into kettle; when melted, add molasses, sugar, and milk.
Stir until sugar is dissolved, and when boiling-point is reached, add chocolate, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted.
Boil until, when tried in cold water, a firm ball may be formed in the fingers.
Add vanilla just after taking from fire.
Turn into a buttered pan, cool, and mark in small squares.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put butter into kettle; when melted, add molasses, sugar, and milk.
2. Stir until sugar is dissolved, and when boiling-point is reached, add chocolate, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted.
3. Boil until, when tried in cold water, a firm ball may be formed in the fingers.
4. Add vanilla just after taking from fire.
5. Turn into a buttered pan, cool, and mark in small squares.
